set.body: Protocol-v1 has two execution ambiguities that must be resolved by a new frozen version before any candidate result is run. First, scenarioGeneration.referencePolicy.nativeCourt requires the same explicit frame-zero reference with native template selection disabled, while the registered nifreeze configuration requires mean-model median leave-one-volume-out prediction. Second, execution.primaryThreadCount and the candidate implementation record four threads, while the only executable RigidExecutionPolicy is DeterministicSerial. Acceptance criteria: (1) choose and encode court-specific reference semantics for every implementation without retrospective normalization; (2) define threadCount as an actual worker count or a core-allocation ceiling and record both requested and effective workers; (3) revise the protocol under its change-control rule before results, retain v1 unchanged, and bind validators/runner to the new digest; (4) add negative validator tests for both contradictions; (5) document permitted comparison language.
set.title: Resolve native reference and effective-thread semantics before benchmarking
